company.name: Lumen
company.description: Lumen is an AI-powered personal health companion that surfaces meaningful patterns in your daily biomarkers. Built for adults who want a calm, evidence-aware view of their wellbeing rather than gamified notifications.
company.target_audience: Health-conscious adults 30-55 who prefer evidence over hype; users of Oura, Whoop, or Apple Watch who want a less competitive interpretation layer.
key_messages: Built around your nervous system, not your streaks

headings.notes: Used at large sizes with tight tracking for an editorial feel

accent.notes: Used for labels and metadata at smaller sizes

visual_style.overall_aesthetic: Calm, premium, editorial. Generous whitespace, low contrast, soft warm neutrals. Reads like a wellness book cover rather than a fitness app.

shapes.border_radius: 16-24px on cards; near-pill (999px) on tags; sharp 0px on dividers

effects.gradients: rare; only soft warm cream-to-linen for background ambience

visual_style.imagery: Soft photography of light and texture; line illustrations; no charts with sharp peaks

components.buttons: Filled forest-dusk with cream label; or ghost with hairline border
components.cards: Off-white surface with 16-24px radius and 0.04 shadow
components.data_viz: Smooth bezier curves over soft sage gridlines; no dots; no labels above 12pt

brand_voice.language_style: Editorial, sentence-cased, never imperative. Avoids exclamation. Uses second-person sparingly.
key_phrases: What your body has been trying to tell you

motion_design.philosophy: Quietly intelligent — soft mask reveals, generous holds, no overshoot. Camera moves are subtle and editorial.

extraction_metadata.confidence_notes: Fabricated brief authored by validation workflow; values internally consistent.
